Properties

NameCodeURITypeDescription
Statusstatushttp://hl7.org/fhir/concept-properties#statuscodeA property that indicates the status of the concept.

Concepts

This case-sensitive code system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/device-availability-status defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinitionStatus
damaged DamagedThe device is damaged.inactive
destroyed DestroyedThe device is destroyed.inactive
available AvailableDevice is fully operational, meets all safety/performance requirements, and is ready for immediate use.
in-use In UseDevice is currently assigned to and actively being used for a patient, procedure, or task.
reserved ReservedDevice is allocated for a future procedure or patient but not yet in active use.
cleaning CleaningDevice is undergoing cleaning or disinfection and cannot be used.
sterilizing SterilizingDevice is in a sterilization process required before reuse.
maintenance MaintenanceDevice is undergoing scheduled or unscheduled maintenance or repair.
calibration CalibrationDevice is being calibrated or verified for accuracy/performance.
charging ChargingDevice is unavailable due to battery recharge cycle.
faulty FaultyDevice has a known malfunction or defect and is not safe for use.
quarantined QuarantinedDevice is isolated pending investigation (e.g., contamination, adverse event).
recalled RecalledDevice is subject to a manufacturer or regulatory recall and must not be used.
out-of-service Out of ServiceDevice is intentionally removed from availability without a specific operational workflow.
retired RetiredDevice has been permanently removed from service but may still exist physically.
disposed DisposedDevice has been permanently discarded or destroyed.
lost LostDevice cannot be located and is not available for use.
in-transit In TransitDevice is being transported between locations and is not available for use.
received-not-ready Received, Not ReadyDevice has been received but not yet inspected, configured, or approved for use.
unknown UnknownDevice availability is not determined.
